title: Naturality of common-stage tensor braiding from rational naturality
statement: Let l be prime, Omega an algebraic closure of Q_l, and W a scheme where l is invertible on residue fields. Use the rational and common-stage constructible categories and tensor functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the prescribed braidings of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Assume that the rational braiding is natural for every pair of arrows at every finite coefficient field E/Q_l. Then for arbitrary common-stage arrows f:M to Mprime and g:N to Nprime, tensor(f,g) followed by beta(Mprime,Nprime) equals beta(M,N) followed by tensor(g,f). No separatedness, permitted-Hom-pair, or lattice-preservation condition is imposed.

source.place: Tensor and internal Hom use the natural identifications; evaluation natural in the two Weil maps. The finite common-field coefficient passage and the prescribed tensor/braiding representative clauses make this naturality explicit.

proof.text: Represent both arbitrary arrows at sufficiently large finite fields using exists_mkHom_eq. Directedness supplies a field L above both fields and the four stages of tensor(M,N), tensor(Mprime,Nprime), tensor(N,M), tensor(Nprime,Mprime). Transport both arrows to L; mkHom_tr preserves their classes. Proof irrelevance identifies all resulting stage-inequality witnesses.

Use the map representative clause of commonStageDerivedTensor_existsUnique and the component representative clause of pullbackTensorCommonBraiding_existsUnique at L. The object clause of the tensor theorem gives the endpoint equalities, and heq_comp identifies the two displayed composites with composites of these representatives.

Composition of two classes represented at L is represented by the composite. Cancel commonStageTensorComparison inverse followed by its forward map. Apply the assumed rational braiding naturality to the transported arrows at Coefficient(l,Omega,L), then conjugate that equality by the remaining source and target tensor comparisons. Equal representatives give equal classes, proving the assertion for all common-stage arrows.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageTensorBraiding_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (hn : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
      [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
      (M M' N N' : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E W)
      (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
      (rationalDerivedTensor l E W).map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫
          (pullbackTensorRationalBraiding l E W M' N').hom =
        (pullbackTensorRationalBraiding l E W M N).hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedTensor l E W).map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (M M' N N' : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω W)
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫
        (pullbackTensorCommonBraiding l Ω W M' N').hom =
      (pullbackTensorCommonBraiding l Ω W M N).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).map (Prod.mkHom g f)
